Package aor.proj3t.resource

Class StatsResource

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.resource.StatsResource
@Path("/stats") @RequestScoped @Produces("application/json") @Consumes("application/json") public class StatsResource extends Object
REST endpoint for statistics-related operations.

This class provides administrative and personal insights regarding users and their training and evaluation activities. It exposes endpoints to retrieve statistics such as manager assignments, evaluation completion rates, yearly training participation, and individualized user stats.
